page.overview:
Who is Doset Tachonis?

is the former Baron of Sloak, and a cousin of Occtis Tachonis. As an NPC, he is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

He was described by Talcydimir Pridesire as a "pretty boy."

Doset was born as a member of House Tachonis, although not into the main branch: he was the second child (and only son) of Lady Nausha Vachari and Segundus Tachonis, younger brother of Lord Primus Tachonis, and had two sisters, Univere (the older) and Tertia (the younger). At some point after he reached adulthood, around the year 69, his family started making moves to control land in Timmony. As part of it, Doset was chosen to become the husband of the Baroness of Sloak, who had inherited the titles and lands of her predecessor, her previous husband; this new and marriage was very short, lasting only nine months, and ended with the death of Lady Sloak, which left Doset as the only heir of the barony in the year 71. Although there was some expectation in Timmony about him becoming the ruler of the region, he ended up designating Casimir Gavendale as his successor (as a way for House Tachonis to pay him for granting them the means to execute Thjazi Fang. The true purpose of Univere and Doset's time in Timmony was harvesting and relocating stolen calcidion.

Lord Doset and his sister Univere had a meeting with the new Baron of Sloak in his new, ruinous castle, giving him the deed of title that had been stolen from him by Talcydimir Pridesire. Casimir was very disappointed with his reward and the fact he didn't get to punish the thief, and spoke rudely to his benefactors, causing Doset to coldly point out that Talcydimir was no longer concern of him, and that Sloak, disappointing as it might be, was more than he deserved.
